assumptions.comparison: Identical tests on all declared boards. Complete local escape on one side may be informative even when the other side is blocked. All original demands retained.
assumptions.contact: Strict center-inside named-anchor is a sufficient diagnostic rule, not an owner-fixed physical constraint. Off-pad contact adequacy is untested.
assumptions.templates: 0.1mm interior samples plus pad center; finite straight edges only. No result excludes other contacts, longer or curved/multisegment escapes.

sweep.margin_scope: Censored collision-screen values, not global minimum clearance. None means no potentially violating object within the complete bounding-box query; no infinite physical margin is claimed.

endpoints.scope: Sufficient center-inside contact; full-width capsules, original foreign obstacles and same rules. Finite local templates only, not exhaustive off-grid/curved escape or whole-route proof.

whole_pad_start_certificate.method: Distance to each exact polygon is1-Lipschitz; minimum retains that bound. Every intersecting pad-box cell has upper=f(center)+half-diagonal+1e-9. Two-obstacle subset overestimates clearance to all obstacles. Ordinary floating engineering enclosure, not directed-rounding proof.
whole_pad_start_certificate.scope: Any start center within this exact pad under full-width capsule and unchanged clearance; off-pad pad-end contacts and altered widths are outside this certificate.
